title: Majestic Promotion
reviewNotes: Montages, captions and native complete diagrams reviewed. Selected eight-piece defensive stalemate mechanism only, after White has promoted to a queen, Black has played Kxc4 and White has captured Be5: White Ka1/Qe5/Nb3/a2/a3/f5 against Kc4/c2, Black to move. The complete boards before and after these captures are visually reviewed; the selected root is their legally replayed intermediate, not an invented caption-only FEN. Black can promote with check on c1 and force Nxc1, which is actual stalemate. Independent analysis checks every Black root move, including all four promotions and Kd3; separate complete non-loss certificates prove this root exactly drawn. This is the same composition in two source clips, not two different games. The music-only clip supplies no chess narration. This scope does not prove all earlier promotion alternatives, claim that White had to choose Qxe5, or certify the complete earlier knight/bishop/rook-underpromotion plan and ten-piece rook conversion. Earlier drafts and review history remain preserved.
